items.title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe
items.summary: This paper introduces Rufus-Air, an open-source recipe for post-training large language models, offering a valuable resource for researchers and developers to enhance LLM performance.

items.title: Airbnb widens access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models
items.summary: Airbnb is expanding its integration of OpenAI's advanced GPT-6 Astra and other frontier models, indicating a growing trend of major companies leveraging cutting-edge AI for enhanced services.

items.title: Everyone's learning to prompt better. That's the wrong skill.
items.summary: This article argues that focusing solely on prompt engineering is a misguided effort, suggesting that the future of AI interaction lies beyond simple prompting.

items.title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
items.summary: Google is piloting a new feature in India that allows users to make purchases directly from Flipkart via Gemini and its AI Mode, integrating AI into e-commerce workflows.

items.title: ChatGPT Ads expands to Southeast Asia and Taiwan
items.summary: OpenAI is expanding its ChatGPT Ads platform to Southeast Asia and Taiwan, indicating a strategic move to monetize its popular AI chatbot in new international markets.

items.title: A Field Guide to AI Documentation: Model Cards, Eval Reports, Agent Cards, and More
items.summary: This guide provides a comprehensive overview of essential documentation practices for AI systems, including model cards and evaluation reports, crucial for transparency and responsible AI development.

items.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
items.summary: Insurance companies are reporting that the adoption of AI technologies is already contributing to a rise in healthcare expenditures, raising concerns about the economic impact of AI in the sector.

items.title: Verifiable Hidden Dynamics Play: Generating Agentic RL Environments from Solved Mechanisms
items.summary: This research explores a novel method for generating complex, agentic reinforcement learning environments by leveraging solved mechanisms, enhancing the development of more sophisticated AI agents.

items.title: PackLab: A Comprehensive Framework for Developing, Training, and Evaluating MLLMs in Robotic Bin Packing
items.summary: PackLab introduces a robust framework designed to facilitate the development, training, and evaluation of Multi-modal Large Language Models specifically for robotic bin packing tasks, advancing AI in logistics and automation.

items.title: MemBodied: Recurrent Associative Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: This paper presents MemBodied, a new approach incorporating recurrent associative memory into Vision-Language-Action models to improve their ability to learn and perform complex tasks.

items.title: Qwen-Planner-Agent: A Closed-Loop AI-for-AI Framework for Real-World Mobile Planner Agents
items.summary: Qwen-Planner-Agent proposes a closed-loop framework for creating real-world mobile planner agents, enabling AI systems to autonomously plan and execute tasks in dynamic environments.

items.title: Building AI to accelerate science and improve lives
items.summary: Google highlights its commitment to developing AI applications that can significantly accelerate scientific discovery and improve various aspects of human life.

items.title: I Built a VS Code Extension to Paste Your Project into Free Chatbots and Apply the Diffs in One Click! 🔥
items.summary: A developer created a VS Code extension that streamlines the process of integrating project code with free chatbots for analysis and applying suggested changes with a single click.

items.title: Hunyuan-A13B Technical Report
items.summary: This technical report details the architecture and performance of Hunyuan-A13B, a new large language model, contributing to the growing landscape of powerful AI models.

items.title: New experts join Google’s AI & Economy team
items.summary: Google has expanded its AI & Economy research team by adding new experts, signaling a continued investment in understanding and shaping the economic implications of AI.
